floodFill.visitedRule: mark on push; an in-bounds neighbour is tested only after a member pixel is popped
floodFill.noOpRule: if the seed equals the replacement, return before the first push

counterRules.operations: 4 seed replacement comparisons; then 8 integer membership operations per popped pixel and 1 visited predicate per in-bounds neighbour test
counterRules.readBytes: 4 seed bytes; then 4 stack bytes and 4 source bytes per pop plus 1 mask byte per neighbour test
counterRules.writeBytes: 5 bytes per push (mask plus u32 stack entry) and 4 output bytes per member pixel
counterRules.changedPixels: member pixels written to the replacement
counterRules.allocations: application-owned buffer allocations during materialization; resident algorithm is zero
counterRules.boundaryCrossings: one resident algorithm call; ingress and egress are copy-phase crossings

passes: horizontal [1,2,1] into uint16 scratch with replicate borders
vertical [1,2,1], add 8 then >>4, write gray RGB and copy source alpha

counterRules.allocations: application-owned buffer allocations during materialization; resident algorithm is zero
counterRules.boundaryCrossings: one resident pipeline call; ingress and egress are copy-phase crossings

phases.contract: verify fixture manifest and allocate target-owned buffers
copy immutable RGBA to target ownership; reset flood output and visited mask
one batched target call with zero application-owned allocation and no validation
copy complete RGBA and, for flood fill, the visited mask to validation ownership
hash complete outputs and assert invariants outside resident compute
one ImageData/putImageData upload of width*height*4 bytes
requestAnimationFrame followed by one queued task; label as a proxy rather than display scanout
